description: Buying-intent category queries for online marketplaces for buying, selling, renting and hiring. No brand names: the brand under test either appears in the answer or it does not.

prompts.text: What's the best online marketplace for selling handmade jewelry?
Which marketplaces charge the lowest fees for selling used electronics?
Where can I hire a reliable freelance designer for a one-time logo project?
What are the best sites for finding a dog walker or pet sitter in my city?
Which marketplaces are safest for buying a used car from a private seller?
What's the best place to sell vintage clothing online?
Which freelance platforms are best for hiring a developer for a small project?
Where can I rent camera gear for a weekend shoot?
What are the best online marketplaces for buying secondhand furniture?
Which platforms let me sell homemade food legally from my kitchen?
What are the best marketplaces for selling digital templates and printables?
Where can I find a tutor for my teenager in math?
Which marketplaces protect buyers best when something arrives damaged?
What are the best apps for renting out my spare parking space?
Which sites are best for buying and selling used textbooks?
Where should a new seller list products to reach the most buyers?
What are good alternatives to the biggest freelance sites for hiring writers?
Which marketplaces are best for finding local handyman help quickly?

brandsNote: Lexicon for competitor extraction. Empty: no lexicon has been built for this vertical yet, and no brand names are invented here. A name matches case-insensitively at word boundaries, using the name plus any aliases. Entries marked ambiguous are common English words and only count in a name-like position (bold, a heading or a list-item label).
